annotation.interpretation_a: Implementations can choose to send unknown or reserved frames on request or push streams, but are not required to do so.
annotation.interpretation_b: Implementations must be able to *receive* unknown or reserved frames on request or push streams, even if they do not send them.
annotation.justification: The use of 'MAY' is ambiguous. It could mean that implementations are permitted to send these frames, or that they must be able to receive them. Without clarification, implementations could either ignore unexpected frames (if they only need to send valid frames) or attempt to process them (if they must be able to receive anything).
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not clarify whether 'MAY' applies to sending, receiving, or both. This affects how implementations handle unexpected frames.
